title: Already rich, already successful, why the last wave of tech winners is grinding again
slides: Why are billionaire founders burning midnight oil again?
The last boom minted fortunes in under five years.
Now the same playbook is failing them completely.
You must rebuild from scratch or watch your lead vanish.
Stop optimizing—start reinventing before the next wave hits.
thread_text:
1. Why the grind is back

Late nights at billionaire offices spiked 40% in Q1 alone.

2. The old fast lane is closed

Previous AI booms turned seed rounds into IPOs in 4 years. That window just shut.

3. Copying the playbook costs you

Every major AI unicorn from the last cycle has lost half its valuation.

4. You cannot iterate your way out

Rebuilding the product architecture is the only move left, not tweaking the UI.

5. What will you strip to zero?

Take one feature that drives 80% of support tickets and kill it this week. If you haven't, start there.

instagram.caption:
Billionaire founders just spent four years building AI unicorns that lost half their value.

The last tech boom turned seed rounds into IPOs in under five years. That fast lane just closed. Copying the old playbook is now a guaranteed way to burn through cash.

If you own a content or publishing business, the product architecture that worked two years ago already doesn't. Iterating on UI won't save you—strip a feature that causes 80% of support tickets this week or watch your lead vanish.

What one thing in your workflow are you still optimizing instead of reinventing? 🔄🔥
